description: Convert firewood volume between cord (128 ft3), stere/Raummeter (stacked m3), solid m3 (Festmeter), loose m3 and ft3, with optional weight estimate by wood species (dry/fresh).

from.description: Input unit: stere = 1 stacked m3, cord = 128 ft3, loose = bulk m3

loose_factor.description: Loose m3 per stacked m3 (1.35-1.55 typical)

solid_factor.description: Solid m3 per stacked m3 (Festmeter/Raummeter, 0.65-0.75 typical) - the weight runs off this

name: firewood_calculator
